# Build exact ring structures of demo1 input via rectangular decomposition.
def layers_of_rect(g,r1,c1,r2,c2):
    res=[]; rr,cc=r1,c1
    while True:
        col=g[rr][cc]
        ok=all(g[rr][k]==col for k in range(cc,c2+1))and all(g[r2][k]==col for k in range(cc,c2+1)) \
           and all(g[a][cc]==col for a in range(rr,r2+1)) and all(g[a][c2]==col for a in range(rr,r2+1))
        if not ok or rr>=r2 or cc>=c2: break
        res.append((col,rr,cc,r2-r1,cc,c2-cc))
        rr+=1; r2-=1; cc+=1; c2-=1
    return res

def bfs_rings(g,cells):
    S=set(cells); rings=[]
    while S:
        fr=set(S); S-=fr
        nxt=set()
        for (a,b) in fr:
            for dx,dy in(-1,0,1):

def solve(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seen=[[False]*len(g[0]) for _ in g]; res=[]
    for i in range(len(g)):
        for j in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[i][j]!=0 and not seen[i][j]:
                comp=[]; s=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True
                while s:
                    y,x=s.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<len(g) and 0<=nx<len(g[0]) and g[ny][nx]!=0 and not seen[ny][nx]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; s.append((ny,nx))
                rs=[a for a,b in comp]; cs=[b for _,b in comp]
                r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
                seq=[]; rr,cc,r1_,c1_=r0,r1,c0,c1; k=0
                while True:
                    b=set(g[rr][cc:c1_+1])|set(g[r1_][cc:c1_+1])|{g[r][cc] for r in range(rr,r1_+1)}|{g[r][c1_] for r in range(rr,r1_+1)}
                    if len(b)!=1 or r1_-rr<1 or c1_-cc<1: break
                    col=b.pop(); seq.append(col); rr+=1; cc+=1; r1_-=1; c1_-=1; k+=1
                rot=[seq[(i+1)%k] for i in range(k)]
                new=[r[:] for r in grid]
                # rebuild box with rotated colors: each ring border replaced by rot index at same ring level
                rr,cc,r1_,c1_=r0,r1,c0,c1
                idx=0
                for kk in range(k):
                    col=rot[kk]
                    # fill current ring border
                    for c in range(cc,c1_+1): new[rr][c]=col
                    for r in range(r1_,rr,-1): new[r][c0]=col
                    rr+=1; cc+=1; r1_-=1; c1_-=1
                res.append(new)
    return res[0]
